**Class (a), measured on `origin/main` with the source quoted.** `walkScreenFlows` iterates `flow.nodes` flat, so a screen nested inside an ADR-0031 region is never reached ⇒ **no skeleton entry and no coverage row**.

⭐ That pairing is what makes it p2 rather than p3: the screen is not merely untranslated, it is **invisible to the thing that reports untranslated strings**. A missing coverage row reads as "nothing to do here", so the gap cannot be found by the mechanism built to find it. ⛔ A silent zero, not a visible failure.

⚠️ **Not a rider on #11745.** That card is `translateFlow`'s region blindness and its declared file surface excludes `packages/cli`; #11745 is `pm:dispatched`, so ⛔ do not fold. ⭐ Same root shape (region-blind flat walks) in two packages — whoever takes this should read #11745's fix for the region-walk it establishes rather than inventing a second one.

## ⭐ Two premise corrections — the card and its triage comment are BOTH stale on this point

**#11745 is `closed`/`completed`, landed 2026-09-10T19:46:18Z as PR #17521 (`bbca4417`, "overlay screen nodes inside ADR-0031 regions in translateFlow").**

Triage's comment (18:28Z) says 「#11745 is `pm:dispatched`, so ⛔ do not fold」. That was true when written and is **false now** — it landed about an hour later. What this changes:

- ✅ **The dependency is satisfied, not in flight.** The region walk you are told to reuse **exists on `origin/main` today**; you are ⛔ not building against a moving target, and there is no sibling-pin/flip-trigger to pre-register.
- ✅ The 「do not fold」 instruction still stands — different package, different unit, and #11745 is closed so there is nothing to fold *into*.

⛔ **Do not quote 「#11745 is pm:dispatched」 in your PR body.** Re-read its state yourself before citing it.

## The landed walk you should reuse — located, with a control

⚠️ **I first measured this symbol as absent and that reading was WRONG.** My grep pattern was bad; a control-driven recheck found it. Stated so you trust the coordinates below over my first pass:

| thing | where, on `origin/main` = `ea2940d1` |
|:--|:--|
| the shared per-flow region descent | **`packages/spec/src/conversions/walk.ts:149`** — `export function mapFlowNodeList(` |
| the region table it reads | **`FLOW_REGION_SLOTS_BY_TYPE`**, `packages/spec/src/automation/region-slots.ts` |
| an existing i18n consumer of it | `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts:58` imports `mapFlowNodeList` from `../conversions/walk.js`; see also its `:3493` docblock, which explains *「WHERE a region lives」* |

⇒ ⭐ **There is one implementation of this descent and a second one must not be born.** `walk.ts:175` says so in its own words: 「The per-flow descent is `mapFlowNodeList`'s — **one implementation**」. Triage's instruction 「read #11745's fix for the region-walk it establishes rather than inventing a second one」 is the same point.

## Zone 1 — RULING (⛔ not re-openable)

1. **A screen node at any region depth is a real screen and owes a live key** — `flows.NAME.screens.NODE_ID.{title,fields.*}`. The card's reasoning is accepted: the executor pauses on it and the client receives its `ScreenSpec.nodeId`.
2. **Reuse the landed region descent; ⛔ do not hand-roll a second region table.** A local copy of the slot list in `packages/cli` is the defect this card is an instance of, one package over.
3. ⛔ **`packages/spec` is not yours to edit.** Import only.

## Zone 2 — PM MECHANICAL ASSUMPTIONS (⭐ falsify freely; a kill here is a good outcome)

| # | assumption | status |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `walkScreenFlows` in `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` still walks `flow.nodes` flat | ⭐ **re-measure** — the card quotes it at length; coordinates move |
| 2 | the file still has **zero** region-awareness (`FLOW_REGION_SLOTS` 0 · `walkFlowNodes` 0 · `config.body` 0 · `try_catch` 0) | ⭐ re-measure; the card's own LIT CONTROL was `'walkScreenFlows'` = 2 — ⛔ take a fresh control, a spent control reads as a failed capture |
| 3 | `mapFlowNodeList` is importable from `packages/cli` without a new dependency edge | ⛔ **NOT measured by me.** `packages/cli`'s dependence on `@objectstack/spec` and whether `conversions/walk.js` is exported through the package's public entry are **yours to establish first**. `check-undeclared-dep-imports.mjs` is in your gate floor and will judge it. If the descent is not reachable from a published entry point, that is a real fork — report it, ⛔ do not deep-import past a package boundary to get around it. |

## Zone 3 — SUGGESTED ROUTE (optional; measurement outranks it)

Route `walkScreenFlows`'s node iteration through the shared region descent so screens nested in `loop.config.body`, `parallel.config.branches[].nodes`, `try_catch.config.try` / `.catch` are reached at arbitrary depth, and emit the same `flows.NAME.screens.NODE_ID.*` entries the flat walk emits today for top-level screens.

⚠️ Mind the **key path**, not just the traversal: the entry is keyed by `NODE_ID`, so a nested screen's key must be stable and collision-free. Say in the report what you did about a nested node id that repeats.

## Acceptance — one named, independently checkable criterion

`os i18n extract` on a flow with a `type: 'screen'` node **inside** a region emits its `flows.NAME.screens.NODE_ID.title` (and `fields.*`) skeleton entry, and the coverage gate gains the corresponding row. ⭐ **Pair it with a top-level screen in the same fixture as the lit control**, so a green proves the descent reached the nested one rather than proving the fixture loaded.

⛔ A test that only asserts "no crash" or "some entries exist" does not measure this card. The defect is a **silent zero** — the assertion must be that a specific previously-missing key is now present.

## Gates

Derive from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands <your ACTUAL changed paths>` on your final diff (⛔ re-derive — the floor is a property of the whole changeset, not of the one file I named). Redirect each and capture `$?` **before** any pipe, then reconcile with `--ran`. Read hit **lines**, ⛔ never hit counts. This lane always adds **`pnpm lint`** (a standing `dispatch-gates` blind spot). ⚠️ `check-undeclared-dep-imports.mjs` is the one most likely to bite assumption 3. A changeset is owed unless `skip-changeset` genuinely applies.

## Report

`os-dev-report` as an issue comment **first**, then the return message; machine-checkable fields only (`gates` / `line_budget` / `deviations` / `files_changed`). ⛔ Do not re-narrate the PR body. Draft PR, target `main`, first line `Fixes #17511`.

⛔ **Do not write a second claim comment** — this one is your identity. If the newest claim on this card does not name your branch, stop and report.
